description.en: A pre-release, self-hosted monitor that checks websites and APIs, opens one incident per failure and sends signed webhooks. It runs on your own server; there is no hosted service.
description.id: Monitor self-hosted tahap pra-rilis yang memeriksa situs dan API, membuka satu insiden per kegagalan, dan mengirim webhook bertanda tangan. Dijalankan di server Anda sendiri; tidak ada layanan terkelola.

description.en: A developer blog for technical articles, developer journal entries, project notes, and FM Work updates. The current site includes clearly marked sample entries.
description.id: Blog pengembang untuk artikel teknis, entri jurnal pengembang, catatan proyek, dan kabar FM Work. Situs saat ini memuat contoh entri yang ditandai dengan jelas.

description.en: A hybrid English academy for children aged 5–12, with teacher, parent and student experiences. The public site is a demo with fictional data, and sign-in is not open.
description.id: Akademi bahasa Inggris hibrida untuk anak usia 5–12 tahun, dengan pengalaman guru, orang tua, dan siswa. Situs publiknya berupa demo dengan data fiktif, dan masuk akun belum dibuka.

description.en: A mobile app for learning JavaScript through short lessons, coding challenges and an illustrated island adventure. An early offline prototype; it is not on any app store.
description.id: Aplikasi seluler untuk belajar JavaScript lewat pelajaran singkat, tantangan koding, dan petualangan pulau bergambar. Prototipe offline tahap awal; belum ada di toko aplikasi.

description.en: Centralized project metadata, schemas, validation, and generated configuration for my developer ecosystem.
A collection of developer learning resources and roadmap content: language notes, practice projects, and role-based and skill-based learning paths.
Creative source files, brand assets and production tooling for the FM Work ecosystem, with a public Creative Museum website.
description.id: File sumber kreatif, aset merek, dan perangkat produksi untuk ekosistem FM Work, dengan situs Museum Kreatif publik.

tagline.id: Padukan ide, lihat apa yang menetas.

description.en: A local-first workspace for combining ingredients into product ideas in the Alchemy Aquarium, then collecting and developing them. Idea Garden and My Space are not built yet.
description.id: Ruang kerja local-first untuk memadukan bahan menjadi ide produk di Alchemy Aquarium, lalu mengumpulkan dan mengembangkannya. Idea Garden dan My Space belum dibuat.

description.en: Shared ecosystem infrastructure for reusable AI-agent skills, reviewed capabilities, and project integrations.
description.id: Infrastruktur bersama ekosistem untuk keterampilan agen AI yang dapat digunakan ulang, kapabilitas yang ditinjau, dan integrasi proyek.

description.en: A browser-local identity hub with local accounts, per-app identities, a consent window and a developer SDK for integration demos. Sessions and verification codes are simulated and stay in your browser; it is not a hosted authentication service.
description.id: Pusat identitas lokal di browser dengan akun lokal, identitas per aplikasi, jendela persetujuan, dan SDK pengembang untuk demo integrasi. Sesi dan kode verifikasi disimulasikan dan tetap di browser Anda; ini bukan layanan autentikasi daring.

tagline.en: A clearer record of what happened.
tagline.id: Catatan lebih jelas tentang yang terjadi.

description.en: A browser-local event logging workspace with a filtered timeline, developer and security views, retention controls and an SDK with a playground for integration demos. Events stay in your browser; it is not a hosted monitoring service.
description.id: Ruang kerja pencatatan peristiwa lokal di browser dengan linimasa berfilter, tampilan pengembang dan keamanan, pengaturan retensi, serta SDK dan playground untuk demo integrasi. Peristiwa tetap di browser Anda; ini bukan layanan pemantauan daring.

tagline.en: Every email your app sends. None of it leaves the browser.
tagline.id: Setiap email dari aplikasimu. Tak satu pun keluar dari browser.

description.en: A browser-local email simulator with a mailbox, templates, local identities and an SDK that lets demo apps deliver messages into it. Delivery is simulated: no real email is ever sent.
description.id: Simulator email lokal di browser dengan kotak surat, templat, identitas lokal, dan SDK agar aplikasi demo dapat mengirim pesan ke dalamnya. Pengirimannya disimulasikan: tidak ada email sungguhan yang dikirim.

description.en: A completed, reusable monorepo architecture for learning, isolated experiments, shared documentation tooling, and application implementations.
description.id: Arsitektur monorepo yang telah selesai dan dapat digunakan ulang untuk pembelajaran, eksperimen terisolasi, perkakas dokumentasi bersama, dan implementasi aplikasi.

description.en: A local-first virtual software studio in development: a manager supervises a team of AI employees through a private dashboard.
A browser-based 3D game creation studio: build and paint worlds, add characters, quests and visual When/If/Then logic, play-test them and export a standalone web game. Projects stay on your device.
description.id: Studio pembuatan gim 3D berbasis browser: bangun dan lukis dunia, tambahkan karakter, misi, dan logika visual Ketika/Jika/Maka, uji mainkan, lalu ekspor menjadi gim web mandiri. Proyek tetap di perangkat Anda.

description.en: A local-first Chrome extension that keeps windows as saved workspaces, with tab search, snapshots and recovery. In development and not yet installable; its 3D worlds are only planned.
description.id: Ekstensi Chrome local-first yang menyimpan jendela sebagai ruang kerja, dengan pencarian tab, snapshot, dan pemulihan. Masih dikembangkan dan belum dapat dipasang; dunia 3D-nya baru rencana.

description.en: A virtual workspace in development, with customizable rooms and avatars for meeting and working together.
description.id: Ruang kerja virtual yang sedang dikembangkan, dengan ruangan dan avatar yang dapat disesuaikan untuk bertemu dan bekerja bersama.

tagline.en: A little place for your next big thing.
tagline.id: Tempat kecil untuk hal besarmu berikutnya.

description.en: A local-first place for saved links, wishlists and plans, with collections and progress tracking. Data stays in your browser, with no account or server.
description.id: Tempat local-first untuk tautan tersimpan, wishlist, dan rencana, lengkap dengan koleksi dan pelacakan progres. Data tetap di browser, tanpa akun atau server.

description.en: A demo inventory management application that uses mock data.

A travel marketplace showcase for stays, flights, activities, transport, events and packages, with customer, host, partner and admin views. Listings are sample data and bookings and payments are simulated: nothing is reserved or charged.
description.id: Showcase marketplace perjalanan untuk penginapan, penerbangan, aktivitas, transportasi, acara, dan paket, dengan tampilan pelanggan, tuan rumah, mitra, dan admin. Daftarnya adalah data contoh; pemesanan dan pembayaran disimulasikan: tidak ada yang benar-benar dipesan atau ditagih.

description.en: A prototype learning platform for Indonesian students from early childhood to senior high, with four age-based worlds and fictional learner profiles. Two illustrative early-childhood games are playable; the other worlds are previews.
description.id: Prototipe platform belajar untuk siswa Indonesia dari PAUD hingga SMA, dengan empat dunia belajar berdasarkan usia dan profil siswa fiktif. Dua gim ilustratif untuk anak usia dini sudah bisa dimainkan; dunia lainnya masih berupa pratinjau.

description.en: A portfolio showcase of a multi-vendor marketplace with customer, seller and administrator views. Everything is simulated and stored in your browser, with no real payments or server.
description.id: Showcase portofolio marketplace multi-penjual dengan tampilan pembeli, penjual, dan administrator. Semuanya disimulasikan dan disimpan di browser, tanpa pembayaran nyata atau server.

tagline.en: One short address for every link worth sharing.
tagline.id: Satu alamat singkat untuk setiap tautan yang layak dibagikan.

description.en: Link sharing and curated resource pages, managed in Notion.
description.id: Halaman berbagi tautan dan kumpulan sumber daya pilihan, dikelola di Notion.

description.en: A browser-local ERP for small and medium businesses, with sales, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, payments and returns connected end to end. All data stays in your browser.
description.id: ERP lokal di browser untuk usaha kecil dan menengah, dengan penjualan, pembelian, inventaris, faktur, pembayaran, dan retur yang terhubung dari awal hingga akhir. Semua data tetap di browser.

tagline.en: Little Roars. Big Adventures. Your Voice!

description.en: An interactive bilingual storybook adventure in development for parents and young children.
description.id: Petualangan buku cerita interaktif dwibahasa yang sedang dikembangkan untuk orang tua dan anak kecil.

description.en: A private, bilingual app for parents of children aged 0–36 months: growth records on WHO standard charts, milestone observations, play activities, parenting guides, a photo journal and in-app reminders, stored on your device. For learning and observation, not medical diagnosis.
description.id: Aplikasi privat dwibahasa untuk orang tua anak usia 0–36 bulan: catatan pertumbuhan pada grafik standar WHO, pengamatan tonggak perkembangan, aktivitas bermain, panduan pengasuhan, jurnal foto, dan pengingat dalam aplikasi, disimpan di perangkat Anda. Untuk belajar dan mengamati, bukan diagnosis medis.

tagline.en: History is waiting to be restored.

description.en: An original third-person 3D mystery exploration game about a forgotten civilization and the Echo Lens. In development; the website is a teaser, with no public demo or download yet.
description.id: Gim eksplorasi misteri 3D orang ketiga tentang peradaban yang terlupakan dan Echo Lens. Sedang dikembangkan; situsnya berupa teaser, belum ada demo atau unduhan publik.

tagline.en: Understand the infrastructure beneath your code.

description.en: A bilingual learning workbench for platform engineering. Today it offers reference drafts, a technology catalog and local reading progress; interactive labs are still in development.
description.id: Ruang belajar dwibahasa untuk rekayasa platform. Saat ini berisi draf referensi, katalog teknologi, dan progres membaca lokal; lab interaktifnya masih dikembangkan.

description.en: Turn presentations into playable worlds.
A colourful collection of mini-games and interactive learning activities for children, featuring puzzles, challenges, and family-friendly multiplayer games.
A curated collection of smaller applications, utilities, experiments, and showcases.
description.id: Koleksi pilihan aplikasi kecil, utilitas, eksperimen, dan showcase.

description.en: A quiz platform in development, with a local quiz editor and solo play, plus simulated sign-in and host-led live sessions.
description.id: Platform kuis yang sedang dikembangkan, dengan editor kuis dan permainan solo lokal, serta simulasi masuk akun dan sesi langsung yang dipandu pembawa acara.

tagline.en: A little space for every thought

description.en: An early prototype of a notebook-style writing app, presented through an interactive notebook landing page. The writing editor is not built yet.
description.id: Prototipe awal aplikasi menulis bergaya buku catatan, ditampilkan lewat halaman depan buku interaktif. Editor penulisan belum tersedia.

description.en: A browser-based motion graphics editor with templates, scenes, text and shapes, entrance effects, a timeline and one audio track, exporting WebM video and PNG frames. Projects stay on your device. Video clip editing, MP4 export and AI features are not available.
description.id: Editor grafis gerak berbasis browser dengan templat, adegan, teks dan bentuk, efek masuk, linimasa, dan satu trek audio, dengan ekspor video WebM dan bingkai PNG. Proyek tetap di perangkat Anda. Pengeditan klip video, ekspor MP4, dan fitur AI belum tersedia.

tagline.en: Capture reality. Create in 3D. Preserve memories.
tagline.id: Tangkap realitas. Berkreasi dalam 3D. Abadikan kenangan.

description.en: A local-first creative space for collecting photos and video frames, turning an image into a 2.5D relief, arranging 3D scenes and keeping memory galleries with tours. It does not reconstruct 3D models by photogrammetry or Gaussian splatting.
description.id: Ruang kreatif yang menyimpan data di perangkat untuk mengumpulkan foto dan bingkai video, mengubah gambar menjadi relief 2,5D, menata adegan 3D, dan menyimpan galeri kenangan dengan tur. Tidak merekonstruksi model 3D lewat fotogrametri atau Gaussian splatting.

tagline.en: Designs for every idea, each with a live preview.
tagline.id: Desain untuk setiap ide, masing-masing dengan pratinjau langsung.

description.en: A curated library of website templates, invitations and digital designs, with live responsive previews and appearance customisation.
description.id: Koleksi pilihan template website, undangan, dan desain digital, dengan pratinjau responsif langsung dan kustomisasi tampilan.

description.en: A local-first API testing and integration workspace for composing requests, inspecting responses and building developer workflows.
description.id: Ruang kerja pengujian dan integrasi API berbasis lokal untuk menyusun request, memeriksa respons dan membangun alur kerja developer.

description.en: A portfolio showcase of business workspaces for shops, cafés, restaurants, salons and laundries, with inventory, customer requests, a point of sale and receipts. All data stays in your browser.
description.id: Showcase portofolio ruang kerja usaha untuk toko, kafe, restoran, salon, dan laundry, dengan inventaris, permintaan pelanggan, kasir, dan struk. Semua data tetap di browser.

tagline.en: Your space. Your data. Your vault.

description.en: A local-first, encrypted vault for secrets, credentials, environment variables and structured notes, with encrypted backups and JSON, CSV or .env export.
description.id: Brankas terenkripsi yang mengutamakan penyimpanan lokal untuk rahasia, kredensial, variabel lingkungan, dan catatan terstruktur, dengan cadangan terenkripsi serta ekspor JSON, CSV, atau .env.

description.en: A macOS desktop app that transcribes recordings on your device with whisper.cpp; live meeting capture is experimental. A local evaluation build exists, but there is no public installer yet.
description.id: Aplikasi desktop macOS yang mentranskripsikan rekaman di perangkat Anda dengan whisper.cpp; perekaman rapat langsung masih eksperimental. Build evaluasi lokal sudah ada, tetapi belum ada installer publik.

tagline.en: Videos you choose, ready for your child.
tagline.id: Video pilihan Anda, siap untuk anak Anda.

description.en: A parent-controlled children's video app in development: parents approve each YouTube video, and a child's tablet plays only what was approved.
description.id: Aplikasi video anak yang dikendalikan orang tua, masih dalam pengembangan: orang tua menyetujui setiap video YouTube, dan tablet anak hanya memutar video yang telah disetujui.

description.en: A local tool for collecting wedding vendor profiles, packages, and reviews from supported directories, with resumable runs and CSV/JSON exports.
description.id: Alat lokal untuk mengumpulkan profil vendor pernikahan, paket, dan ulasan dari direktori yang didukung, dengan proses yang dapat dilanjutkan serta ekspor CSV/JSON.

description.en: A local-first money tracker with wallets, budgets, recurring bills and analytics. Data stays in your browser, with no account or cloud sync.
description.id: Pencatat keuangan local-first dengan dompet, anggaran, tagihan berulang, dan analitik. Data tetap di browser, tanpa akun dan tanpa sinkronisasi cloud.

description.en: A multi-skill learning platform in development, starting with interactive JavaScript challenges and local progress, with learning paths and more skill areas planned.
description.id: Platform belajar berbagai keterampilan yang sedang dikembangkan, dimulai dengan tantangan JavaScript interaktif dan kemajuan yang disimpan secara lokal, dengan jalur belajar dan bidang keterampilan lain yang direncanakan.

description.en: A local-first study app in development, with learning plans, focus sessions and progress tracking, alongside customizable room prototypes.
description.id: Aplikasi belajar berbasis lokal yang sedang dikembangkan, dengan rencana belajar, sesi fokus dan pelacakan kemajuan, serta prototipe ruangan yang dapat disesuaikan.

description.en: An early build of a portfolio showcase for a workspace-first enterprise HRIS, with company workspaces, role-based consoles, simulated payroll and an employee mobile app. All data stays in your browser.
description.id: Build awal showcase portofolio HRIS enterprise berbasis workspace, dengan ruang kerja perusahaan, konsol berbasis peran, simulasi penggajian, dan aplikasi karyawan seluler. Semua data tetap di browser.

description.en: A standalone SAP-inspired enterprise suite showcase covering procurement, sales, manufacturing, inventory, finance, HR, assets, quality, projects and approvals with demo companies. SAP and Odoo connectors are simulated; it is not affiliated with either vendor and is not a production ERP.
description.id: Showcase mandiri suite perusahaan yang terinspirasi SAP: pengadaan, penjualan, manufaktur, inventaris, keuangan, SDM, aset, mutu, proyek, dan persetujuan dengan perusahaan demo. Konektor SAP dan Odoo disimulasikan; tidak berafiliasi dengan kedua vendor dan bukan ERP untuk produksi.

tagline.en: Your local dev. A world of its own.

description.en: A local-first macOS desktop app that shows your running local services as buildings on floating islands. A preview exists, but there is no public download yet.
description.id: Aplikasi desktop macOS local-first yang menampilkan layanan lokal Anda sebagai bangunan di pulau melayang. Pratinjaunya sudah ada, tetapi belum ada unduhan publik.

description.en: A local-first visual workspace for diagrams, ERDs, mind maps, documents and whiteboards that stay connected.
description.id: Ruang kerja visual berbasis lokal untuk diagram, ERD, peta pikiran, dokumen, dan papan tulis yang saling terhubung.

description.en: Developed a page builder and rendering engine for drag-and-drop website creation, frontend applications with Vue.js and Nuxt.js, and Node.js migration scripts for legacy data.
Contributed to a company product by developing a drag-and-drop website page builder and rendering engine, including live preview and publishing workflows.
description.id: Berkontribusi pada produk perusahaan dengan mengembangkan page builder situs web berbasis drag-and-drop beserta rendering engine, termasuk pratinjau langsung dan alur publikasi.

description.en: Developed Node.js scripts for converting and migrating legacy data.
description.id: Mengembangkan skrip Node.js untuk mengonversi dan memigrasikan data lama.

description.en: Developed payment microservices integrating Midtrans and Xendit with Go and Redis, migrated legacy Python services to Go, and built backend services for course management, cart, email and vouchers.
Developed payment services integrating Midtrans and Xendit payment gateways.
Developed product-related backend services and supporting functionality, including email and other services.
Developed and maintained CMS and client-facing web applications for a confidential fintech project while working with Rolling Glory.
Developed and maintained CMS and client-facing web applications for a confidential fintech project while working with Rolling Glory.
Taught JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Express.js and PostgreSQL to full-stack bootcamp students, and built an internal grading system and GitHub Classroom automation scripts.
Developed an internal system to support student assignment grading and assessment.
Developed scripts to automate cloning, archiving and testing student repositories.
description.id: Mengembangkan skrip untuk mengotomatiskan proses kloning, pengarsipan, dan pengujian repositori siswa.

description.en: Developed and maintained enterprise web platforms for membership, apartment, travel, hotel and document management, including business workflows, ERDs, REST APIs and Nginx deployments.
Developed and maintained a membership management web application.
Developed and maintained an apartment management web application.
Developed and maintained a hotel-related web application.
Developed and maintained a residential management web application.
Developed and maintained a travel-related web application.
Developed and maintained a digital document management web application.

Build and maintain APIs, backend services and features across customer-facing and internal applications, and contribute to platform architecture, shared infrastructure, reliability, observability and testing.
Developed and enhanced production features for a Next.js and TypeScript web application, including bug fixes, performance improvements, refactoring, and monitoring with Sentry and Matomo.

Developed web and mobile applications for a mining operations platform, including a block builder for mining planning, live camera and video management, dashboards, and a React Native task management app.
Block builder application for mining planning and operations.
Camera management with live streaming and video management.
Administrative dashboard.
React Native application for task management.
Led frontend development for a token loyalty platform, including a landing page, client PWA, and admin dashboard with QR token collection, redemption and reward management.
Progressive web application supporting token collection and redemption.
Dashboard supporting token and reward management.

freelance.title: Automotive Spare Parts Inventory Management System

description.en: Designed and developed an inventory management CMS for an automotive spare parts retailer, including REST APIs and frontend modules for products, inventory, locations and orders.
description.id: Merancang dan mengembangkan CMS manajemen inventaris untuk pengecer suku cadang otomotif, termasuk REST API dan modul frontend untuk produk, inventaris, lokasi, dan pesanan.

description.en: Developed real-time ship monitoring applications with interactive maps, playback, radar visualization, geofencing and CCTV management.
Audited an existing web platform, identified feature gaps through technical and UI reviews, and planned development roadmaps and sprint backlogs.
A Next.js application for creating and managing AI conversation sessions, with a pluggable AI provider, simulated delays and failures, error monitoring, dark mode and unit tests.
description.id: Aplikasi Next.js untuk membuat dan mengelola sesi percakapan AI, dengan penyedia AI yang dapat diganti, simulasi penundaan dan kegagalan, pemantauan kesalahan, mode gelap, dan pengujian unit.

description.en: A Nuxt storefront with product listings, categories, search and product detail pages, using Pinia and server API routes over mock product data.
description.id: Etalase toko berbasis Nuxt dengan daftar produk, kategori, pencarian, dan halaman detail produk, menggunakan Pinia serta rute API server berbasis data produk tiruan.

description.en: An Angular employee management app with login, a dashboard, and employee list, detail and create pages backed by a mock JSON API.
JavaScript algorithm exercises covering palindromes, random arrays and sorting, alongside a Vue kanban board using Vuex state management.
A Vue and Quasar data table with search, filtering, single and bulk update and delete, and Jest unit tests.
A GraphQL API for the meeting room booking service, exposing users, rooms and bookings through Apollo Server on top of the REST API.
A meeting room booking REST API with authentication, room and booking management, MySQL migrations and seeders, and email notifications.
Continued learning through Python, React, Laravel, React Native and Kotlin, including coursework, coding exercises, quizzes and final projects.
A Vue carousel synchronized across viewers in real time using Socket.io to broadcast slide changes.
A three-part e-commerce application with a tested REST API, an admin dashboard for managing products, categories and users, and a customer storefront with cart and checkout functionality.
A full-stack Kanban board with a REST API and Vue client, supporting categories, tasks, Google Sign-In and per-user authorization.
Attack Wars is a turn-based browser battle game built with JavaScript, featuring a story intro, hero naming, difficulty levels, critical attacks, spells and replay.
A multi-page coding-course website concept with lessons, a playground and a quiz, built using HTML and CSS.
